sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can consolidate the Kárpát-medence's pre-Magyar history: early peoples, Roman Pannonia, the Migration Period and the eve of the honfoglalás.
I can name the main peoples who lived in the basin before 895, in the correct rough order.
I can explain why no single power unified the Kárpát-medence before the Magyars arrived.
I can review this unit's vocabulary and grammar (multi-subject past narration, sequencing words, míg clauses).
